x: Since our last issue we welcome new lads to our fold; Ian Boss, Harold Burton, Dennis Ives, Patrick Maloney, Gordon Smith and Harry Stallard, also the return of Alf Joels who has resumed his membership.

This race saw the return to the Club of one of our war time members, Alf Joels and although he did not complete the distance it was obvious that with some training he can be an added strength to our distance men.
George Beecham walked an excellent first Brighton to gain a first class standard and Rolfe, Doub, and Joe Wilson gained 2nd class standards, as also did Alf Joels who was in the "B" Team.
